            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2 id="AI 生成代码的原理：知识从哪里来">AI 生成代码的原理：知识从哪里来</h2>
<h3 id="大模型并不">大模型并不"认识"你的系统</h3>
<p>很多人第一次使用 Cursor 生成接口测试时会困惑， 大模型怎么知道我的系统的接口张什么样子？如果我们强行让它写，它绝对会写出一个假的的测试用例。这是因为大模型没有你系统的任何知识。它只能根据通用经验"猜"出一个看起来合理的接口，但猜的结果和你真实的系统大概率对不上。</p>
<p>AI 要生成准确的测试代码，前提是你必须先把接口知识喂给它。</p>
<h3 id="知识的最佳来源：API 文档">知识的最佳来源：API 文档</h3>
<p>如果你的团队有完善的 API 文档（Swagger、Postman Collection、API Blueprint 等），直接把相关接口文档丢给 AI 就可以了。</p>
<p>在 Cursor 中，你就可以：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">（Agent 模式）

@docs</span>/api/order-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">api.md   ← 引用文档文件

根据以上接口文档，帮我编写创建订单接口的完整测试用例，
包含正常创建、缺少必填字段、金额为负数三个场景。</span></pre>
</div>
<p>AI 拿到文档后，可以准确理解接口的路径、方法、入参、返回值，生成的代码会非常准确。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="没有文档怎么办：用 F12 抓包">没有文档怎么办：用 F12 抓包</h3>
<p>现实情况是，很多团队的 API 文档严重滞后于代码，甚至根本没有文档。这时候最直接的办法是用浏览器开发者工具（F12）抓包。</p>
<p>PS： 我就是这么干的。</p>
<h4 id="操作步骤">操作步骤</h4>
<p>第一步：打开浏览器，进入你要测试的功能页面，按&nbsp;<code>F12</code>&nbsp;打开开发者工具，切换到&nbsp;Network&nbsp;标签页。</p>
<p>第二步：执行你要测试的操作（比如点击"创建订单"按钮），观察 Network 面板捕获到的请求。</p>
<p>第三步：找到目标请求，右键 →&nbsp;Copy → Copy as cURL，或者手动记录以下信息：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>接口路径：   POST /api/v2/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">orders
请求头：     Content</span>-Type: application/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">json
             Authorization: Bearer </span>&lt;token&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
请求体：     {
               </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">product_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">prod_001</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
               </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">quantity</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
               </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">address_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">addr_123</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
               </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">coupon_code</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">SAVE10</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
               </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">remark</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">请尽快发货</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
             }
响应状态码：  </span>201<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
响应体：     {
               </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">code</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: 0,
               </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">message</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">success</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
               </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">data</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
                 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">order_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ord_20260613_001</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">status</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pending</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">total_amount</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: 198.00<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">created_at</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">2026-06-13T14:00:00Z</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
               }
             }</span></pre>
</div>
<p>第四步：把抓到的信息 + 对功能的简单描述一起给 AI：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">（Agent 模式）

我抓到了一个创建订单的接口，信息如下：

接口：POST </span>/api/v2/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">orders
请求体：
{
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">product_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">prod_001</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">quantity</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">address_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">addr_123</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">coupon_code</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">SAVE10</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">remark</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">请尽快发货</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
}
响应（成功）：
{
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">code</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: 0,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">data</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">order_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ord_20260613_001</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">status</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pending</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">total_amount</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: 198.00<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  }
}

功能说明：用户选好商品后，提交订单。product_id 和 quantity 是必填的，
address_id 是收货地址，coupon_code 是优惠券（可选），remark 是备注（可选）。

请根据以上信息，帮我编写完整的接口测试用例。</span></pre>
</div>
<hr>
<h3 id="AI 会">AI 会"推理"你没说清楚的部分</h3>
<p>你会发现，上面的描述并没有告诉 AI 每个字段的所有细节（比如 quantity 的取值范围、product_id 的格式约束）。但这没关系——大模型会根据你描述的业务功能，自主推理出合理的测试边界。</p>
<p>比如 AI 会自动推断：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>quantity</code>&nbsp;可能有最小值（不能为 0 或负数）</li>
<li><code>coupon_code</code>&nbsp;是可选字段，需要测试不传的情况</li>
<li><code>product_id</code>&nbsp;不存在时应该报错</li>
<li>库存不足时应该有对应的错误响应</li>
</ul>
<p>AI 生成的测试用例可能包含你没想到的边界场景，这正是它的价值所在。</p>
<p>当 AI 推理错了怎么办？</p>
<p>直接纠正它：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>你刚才假设 quantity 最大值是 99，实际上我们的系统限制是 999<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">，
而且当超过库存数量时才会报错，不是超过 </span>999 就报错。请修正。</pre>
</div>
<p>AI 会立刻根据你的纠正更新测试用例，并自动调整相关的边界测试场景。这个过程类似于"代码审查"——AI 写草稿，你来校正，效率远高于从零手写。 当然也可以从一开始就把完整的测试用例给 AI， 这样就不用 AI 自己瞎猜了， 事实上我们项目中基本都是这样的。 但如果我们刚刚开始接受项目， 还没有完善的测试用例的时候， 也可以让 AI 自己去探索， 然后我们来纠正的这样一个模式。</p>
<p>那么接下来问题就来了， 以后我们每写一个自动化测试用例，都需要这么麻烦的去抓每个接口的包么？ 事实上我们之前抓过的接口是不用重新给大模型的，这就涉及到 AI 编程最重要的一个部分了， 就是语义检索。</p>
<hr>
<h2 id="语义检索：存量代码就是最好的参考">语义检索：存量代码就是最好的参考</h2>
<h3 id="Cursor 的代码库索引机制">Cursor 的代码库索引机制</h3>
<p>当你在 Cursor 中打开一个项目，Cursor 会在后台自动对整个代码库做 Embedding（向量化），并存入向量数据库。</p>
<p>这意味着：</p>
<ul>
<li>你写的每一行代码，Cursor 都"读"过了</li>
<li>当你提出新的需求时，AI 会通过语义检索找到项目中最相关的代码作为参考</li>
<li>它不是简单的关键词匹配，而是理解代码的语义含义</li>
</ul>
<p>你可以在 Cursor 右下角看到索引进度：<code>Indexing codebase... (234/312 files)</code>，索引完成后所有文件都可以被语义检索到。</p>
<p>PS：版本不同，这段信息的位置可能会有所不同。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="存量代码如何成为">存量代码如何成为"活文档"</h3>
<p>让我们看一个具体的例子。</p>
<p>假设你按照第之前教程的方法，已经写好了第一个测试用例：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> tests/order/test_create_order.py</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TestCreateOrder:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> test_create_order_success(self, api_client):
        response </span>= api_client.post(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/api/v2/orders</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, json=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">product_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">prod_001</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">quantity</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">address_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">addr_123</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        })
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">assert</span> response.status_code == 201<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        data </span>= response.json()[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">data</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">assert</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">order_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> data
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">assert</span> data[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">status</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>] == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pending</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></pre>
</div>
<p>现在你想写"查询订单详情"的测试用例，你只需要告诉 AI：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">帮我编写一个查询订单的测试用例。 它的测试步骤：

</span>1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 创建订单，获取订单ID
</span>2. 查询订单， 检验XXXXXX。 PS: 如果查询订单之前没有写过相关用例， 这里也需要去抓查询订单的接口的包。</pre>
</div>
<p>此时 AI 不需要你重新解释创建订单的接口，大模型通过语义检索已经找到了&nbsp;<code>test_create_order.py</code>，直接参考现有风格生成新用例：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> AI 自动生成，风格与现有代码完全一致</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TestGetOrder:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> test_get_order_success(self, api_client):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 先创建一个订单，再查询它</span>
        create_resp = api_client.post(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/api/v2/orders</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, json=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">product_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">prod_001</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">quantity</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">address_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">addr_123</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        })
        order_id </span>= create_resp.json()[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">data</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>][<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">order_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]

        response </span>= api_client.get(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/api/v2/orders/{order_id}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">assert</span> response.status_code == 200<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        data </span>= response.json()[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">data</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">assert</span> data[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">order_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>] ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> order_id
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">assert</span> data[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">status</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>] == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pending</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">assert</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">items</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> data</pre>
</div>
<p>关键点：甚至你可以只说"查询订单详情"，AI 自己知道要先创建订单再查询（因为它从已有代码中理解了这个业务流程）。</p>
<p>当然这样的形式实在过于代码冗余了，我们需要更灵活的接口，以及让我们的知识更加的简单。 毕竟以后代码库里的 case 越来越多， 大模型的语义检索能力也会收到干扰，并且我们的测试用例也得分层，不能把所有东西都写在用例里， 需要把 API，业务逻辑等等单独分层。 那怎么办呢？ 看下面的内容。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="增量知识积累">增量知识积累</h3>
<p>这就是语义检索带来的核心价值：项目里的代码越多，AI 能参考的知识越多，生成的代码质量越高。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">第1个接口测试  →  AI 需要你提供完整接口信息
第5个接口测试  →  AI 已经理解了你的项目结构和风格
第20个接口测试 →  AI 直接参考存量代码，你只需说</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">仿照 XXX 写一个 YYY</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
第50个接口测试 →  AI 几乎不需要额外解释，自主完成</span></pre>
</div>
<p>实践建议：</p>
<ul>
<li>每次引入一个新模块时，先手动写（或精心指导 AI 写）一个"示范性"测试用例</li>
<li>这个示范用例会成为该模块所有后续测试的参考基准</li>
<li>后续只需要增量录入新的业务知识（新字段、新规则），存量的调用方式 AI 自己会找</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2 id="当代码多起来：Service 层抽象">当代码多起来：Service 层抽象</h2>
<h3 id="语义检索也会">语义检索也会"迷路"</h3>
<p>随着项目发展，测试代码会越来越多。假设你已经有了 100 个测试文件，每个文件里都有调用各种接口的代码。这时候会出现两个问题：</p>
<p>问题一：同一功能有多种实现方式</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 测试文件 A 里创建订单的方式</span>
api_client.post(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/api/v2/orders</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, json={<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">product_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">p1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">quantity</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, ...})

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 测试文件 B 里（早期写的，字段名不一样）</span>
api_client.post(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/api/v2/orders</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, json={<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">productId</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">p1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">qty</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, ...})

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 测试文件 C 里（用了另一套封装）</span>
order_service.create(product=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">p1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, count=1)</pre>
</div>
<p>AI 做语义检索时，可能找到旧的、不规范的写法，导致生成的代码风格不一致，甚至用了已经废弃的字段名。</p>
<p>问题二：检索噪音增大</p>
<p>100 个文件里有大量相似的接口调用代码，AI 在检索时需要处理大量干扰项，可能反而找不到最相关的参考，生成质量下降。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="解决方案：API 层 + Service 层">解决方案：API 层 + Service 层</h3>
<p>工程化的解法是将代码分成三层：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>tests/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">          ← 测试用例层（只关心测试逻辑）
  └── order</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      └── test_create_order.py

services</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">       ← 业务逻辑层（封装多个接口的串联调用）
  └── order_service.py

api</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            ← 接口调用层（每个接口对应一个函数，一处定义）
  └── order_api.py</span></pre>
</div>
<h4 id="api/order_api.py：接口调用层"><code>api/order_api.py</code>：接口调用层</h4>
<p>每个接口只在这里定义一次，是整个工程的"接口字典"：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> api/order_api.py</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
订单模块接口定义
所有订单相关接口的调用都从这里发出，禁止在测试文件中直接拼接接口路径。
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> utils.http_client <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> APIClient


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_order(client: APIClient, product_id: str, quantity: int,
                 address_id: str, coupon_code: str </span>= None, remark: str =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">创建订单</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    payload </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">product_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: product_id,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">quantity</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: quantity,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">address_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: address_id,
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> coupon_code:
        payload[</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">coupon_code</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>] =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> coupon_code
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> remark:
        payload[</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">remark</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>] =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> remark
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> client.post(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/api/v2/orders</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, json=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">payload)


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> get_order(client: APIClient, order_id: str):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">查询订单详情</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> client.get(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/api/v2/orders/{order_id}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> list_orders(client: APIClient, page: int = 1, page_size: int = 20, status: str =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">查询订单列表</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    params </span>= {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">page</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: page, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">page_size</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: page_size}
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> status:
        params[</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">status</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>] =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> status
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> client.get(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/api/v2/orders</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, params=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">params)


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cancel_order(client: APIClient, order_id: str, reason: str):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">取消订单</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> client.post(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/api/v2/orders/{order_id}/cancel</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, json={<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">reason</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: reason})</pre>
</div>
<h4 id="services/order_service.py：业务逻辑层"><code>services/order_service.py</code>：业务逻辑层</h4>
<p>把需要多个接口串联的常见业务流程封装成公共方法：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> services/order_service.py</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
订单业务逻辑层
封装常用的多步骤业务流程，供测试用例直接调用。
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> api.order_api <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_order, get_order, cancel_order
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> utils.http_client <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> APIClient


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_and_get_order(client: APIClient, product_id: str, quantity: int,
                          address_id: str) </span>-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dict:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
    创建订单并立即查询，返回完整订单信息。
    适用于需要验证创建后状态的测试场景。
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    create_resp </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_order(client, product_id, quantity, address_id)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">assert</span> create_resp.status_code == 201, f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">创建订单失败: {create_resp.text}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    order_id </span>= create_resp.json()[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">data</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>][<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">order_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]

    get_resp </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> get_order(client, order_id)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">assert</span> get_resp.status_code == 200
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> get_resp.json()[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">data</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> create_pending_order(client: APIClient) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> str:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
    使用默认参数快速创建一个待支付订单，返回 order_id。
    适用于其他测试（如支付测试、取消测试）的前置条件。
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    resp </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_order(
        client,
        product_id</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">prod_test_001</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        quantity</span>=1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        address_id</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">addr_test_001</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    )
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">assert</span> resp.status_code == 201
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> resp.json()[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">data</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>][<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">order_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>]</pre>
</div>
<h4 id="测试文件如何使用这两层">测试文件如何使用这两层</h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> tests/order/test_create_order.py</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> api.order_api <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_order
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> services.order_service <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_and_get_order

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TestCreateOrder:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> test_create_order_success(self, api_client):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">正常创建订单</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        order </span>= create_and_get_order(api_client, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">prod_001</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, 2, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">addr_123</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">assert</span> order[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">status</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>] == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pending</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">assert</span> order[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">total_amount</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>] &gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> test_create_order_missing_product_id(self, api_client):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">缺少必填字段 product_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        resp </span>= create_order(api_client, product_id=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span>, quantity=1, address_id=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">addr_123</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">assert</span> resp.status_code == 400
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">assert</span> resp.json()[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">message</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>] == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">product_id 不能为空</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></pre>
</div>
<hr>
<h3 id="分层架构对 AI 的好处">分层架构对 AI 的好处</h3>
<p>有了 API 层 + Service 层之后，AI 做语义检索的效果会大幅提升：</p>
<table class="table-responsive table table-bordered table-striped">
<tbody>
<tr><th>没有分层</th><th>有分层</th></tr>
<tr>
<td>AI 在 100 个测试文件里搜索"如何调用创建订单接口"</td>
<td>AI 直接检索到&nbsp;<code>api/order_api.py</code>，一处即知</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>找到多种写法，不知道用哪个</td>
<td>接口层唯一，写法统一</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>多步骤流程散落在各个测试文件里</td>
<td>Service 层集中封装，直接复用</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>新测试参考旧测试，风格越来越乱</td>
<td>新测试参考 API 层和 Service 层，风格一致</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>升级后的工程目录结构：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>api-autotest/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
├── api</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                    ← 接口调用层（每个接口定义一次）
│   ├── order_api.py
│   ├── user_api.py
│   └── product_api.py
├── services</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">               ← 业务逻辑层（多接口串联的公共流程）
│   ├── order_service.py
│   └── user_service.py
├── tests</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                  ← 测试用例层（只关心测试逻辑）
│   ├── order</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
│   ├── user</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
│   └── product</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
├── utils</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
├── fixtures</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
├── config</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
├── conftest.py
└── pytest.ini</span></pre>
</div>
<hr>
<h2 id="Rules 文件：让 AI 遵守你的工程规范">Rules 文件：让 AI 遵守你的工程规范</h2>
<h3 id="为什么需要 Rules 文件">为什么需要 Rules 文件</h3>
<p>有了分层架构之后，还有一个问题：AI 不知道你定了这些规范。</p>
<p>下次你让 AI 写测试用例时，它可能还是会在测试文件里直接写&nbsp;<code>api_client.post("/api/v2/orders", ...)</code>，而不是调用你封装好的&nbsp;<code>create_order()</code>&nbsp;函数。</p>
<p>解决方法是使用&nbsp;Cursor Rules 文件——这是 Cursor 的一个核心功能，让你可以把工程规范直接"写给 AI 看"，让它在每次生成代码时都遵守这些规则。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="Rules 文件是什么">Rules 文件是什么</h3>
<p>Rules 文件本质上是附加在每次 AI 对话中的系统提示词（System Prompt）。你在 Rules 文件里写的内容，会在每次 AI 生成代码前被自动注入，让 AI 理解你的项目规范。</p>
<p>Cursor 支持两种 Rules：</p>
<table class="table-responsive table table-bordered table-striped">
<tbody>
<tr><th>类型</th><th>存放位置</th><th>作用范围</th></tr>
<tr>
<td>Project Rules</td>
<td><code>.cursor/rules/*.mdc</code></td>
<td>只对当前项目生效</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>User Rules</td>
<td>Cursor Settings → Rules</td>
<td>对所有项目全局生效</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>推荐方案：工程规范放 Project Rules，个人偏好（比如"回复用中文"）放 User Rules。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="如何创建 Rules 文件">如何创建 Rules 文件</h3>
<h4 id="方法一：通过 Cursor 界面创建（推荐新手）">方法一：通过 Cursor 界面创建（推荐新手）</h4>
<ol>
<li>打开 Cursor，进入你的项目</li>
<li>按&nbsp;<code>Cmd+Shift+P</code>（macOS）/&nbsp;<code>Ctrl+Shift+P</code>（Windows）打开命令面板</li>
<li>输入&nbsp;<code>New Cursor Rule</code>，回车</li>
<li>输入规则名称（比如&nbsp;<code>api-test-rules</code>），回车</li>
<li>Cursor 会自动在&nbsp;<code>.cursor/rules/</code>&nbsp;目录下创建&nbsp;<code>api-test-rules.mdc</code>&nbsp;文件</li>
</ol>
<h4 id="方法二：手动创建">方法二：手动创建</h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>mkdir -p .cursor/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">rules
touch .cursor</span>/rules/api-test-rules.mdc</pre>
</div>
<p>然后用 Cursor 打开这个文件，开始编写规则内容。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="4.4 Rules 文件的格式">4.4 Rules 文件的格式</h3>
<p><code>.mdc</code>&nbsp;文件支持 Markdown 格式，开头有一段 YAML Front Matter 用于配置规则的触发时机：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
description: 接口自动化工程编码规范
globs:        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 匹配哪些文件时触发此规则</span>
  - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tests/**/*.py</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
  - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">api/**/*.py</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
  - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">services/**/*.py</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
alwaysApply: false   </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 是否对所有文件始终生效</span>
---</pre>
</div>
<pre class="highlight yaml"><code style="font-size: 14px">globs</code><span style="font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px">&nbsp;的作用：当 AI 正在操作匹配这些路径的文件时，自动附加此规则。比如你正在写测试文件，Rules 会自动生效，不需要你手动提醒 AI。</span></pre>
<p><code>alwaysApply: true</code>：如果你希望所有操作都遵守这条规则（比如"始终用中文回复"），可以设置为 true。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="4.5 为接口测试工程编写 Rules 文件">4.5 为接口测试工程编写 Rules 文件</h3>
<p>下面是一个完整的示例，可以直接用于你的接口测试工程：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
description: 接口自动化工程编码规范
globs:
  </span>- <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tests/**/*.py</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
  - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">api/**/*.py</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
  - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">services/**/*.py</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
alwaysApply: false
</span>---

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 接口自动化工程编码规范</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"># 工程结构</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
本工程采用三层架构，职责如下：
</span>- `api/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">`：接口调用层，每个接口有且只有一处定义，命名规范为 `{模块名}_api.py`
</span>- `services/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">`：业务逻辑层，封装需要多接口串联的公共业务流程
</span>- `tests/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">`：测试用例层，只关注测试逻辑，不直接拼接接口路径

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"># 编写测试用例的强制规范</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">## 1. 禁止在测试文件中直接调用 HTTP 客户端</span>

**错误示范**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">（禁止）：

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> test_create_order(api_client):
    api_client.post(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/api/v2/orders</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, json={...})  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ❌ 禁止</span>


**正确示范**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">：

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> api.order_api <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_order
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> services.order_service <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_pending_order

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> test_create_order(api_client):
    resp </span>= create_order(api_client, ...)  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ✅ 使用 api 层</span>


<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">## 2. 优先使用 Service 层的公共方法</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
当一个操作需要多步接口调用时，优先检查 `services</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">` 目录下是否已有封装好的方法。
例如需要</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">创建订单后查询</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">时，使用 `order_service.create_and_get_order()`，
而不是手动写两次接口调用。

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">## 3. 新增接口时必须先在 api 层定义</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
如果需要调用一个 `api</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">` 目录下还没有的接口，必须先在对应的 `{模块}_api.py` 文件中定义该接口函数，然后再在测试文件中引用。

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">## 4. 测试用例命名规范</span>

-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 文件名：`test_{被测功能}.py`（如 `test_create_order.py`）
</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 类名：`Test{功能名驼峰}` （如 `TestCreateOrder`）
</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 方法名：`test_{场景描述}`（如 `test_create_order_missing_product_id`）

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">## 5. 断言规范</span>

-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 必须断言 HTTP 状态码
</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 必须断言响应体中的核心业务字段
</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 错误场景必须断言错误信息的具体内容（`message` 字段）

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"># 语言规范</span>

-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 所有代码注释使用中文
</span>- docstring 必须说明：函数功能、适用测试场景</pre>
</div>
<hr>
<h3 id="4.6 Rules 文件生效后的效果">4.6 Rules 文件生效后的效果</h3>
<p>有了这个 Rules 文件，当你告诉 AI：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>帮我写一个支付订单的测试用例，接口是 POST /api/v2/orders/{order_id}/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">pay，
需要先有一个待支付的订单</span></pre>
</div>
<p>AI 会自动：</p>
<ol>
<li>检查&nbsp;<code>api/order_api.py</code>&nbsp;是否已有&nbsp;<code>pay_order()</code>&nbsp;函数，没有的话先补充</li>
<li>检查&nbsp;<code>services/order_service.py</code>&nbsp;是否有&nbsp;<code>create_pending_order()</code>&nbsp;可复用，有的话直接用</li>
<li>生成符合命名规范的测试类和方法名</li>
<li>断言状态码 + 业务字段</li>
</ol>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> AI 按照 Rules 规范自动生成：</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 先补充 api 层（如果没有）</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> api/order_api.py</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pay_order(client: APIClient, order_id: str, payment_method: str):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">支付订单</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> client.post(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/api/v2/orders/{order_id}/pay</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                       json</span>={<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">payment_method</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: payment_method})

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 测试用例（复用了 Service 层的 create_pending_order）</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> tests/order/test_pay_order.py</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> api.order_api <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pay_order
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> services.order_service <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_pending_order

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TestPayOrder:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> test_pay_order_success(self, api_client):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">正常支付：使用微信支付成功场景</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        order_id </span>= create_pending_order(api_client)  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 复用 Service 层</span>
        resp = pay_order(api_client, order_id, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">wechat</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">assert</span> resp.status_code == 200
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">assert</span> resp.json()[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">data</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>][<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">status</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>] == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">paid</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> test_pay_order_already_paid(self, api_client):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">异常：重复支付已完成的订单</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        order_id </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_pending_order(api_client)
        pay_order(api_client, order_id, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">wechat</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 第一次支付</span>
        resp = pay_order(api_client, order_id, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">wechat</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 第二次支付</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">assert</span> resp.status_code == 409
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">assert</span> resp.json()[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">message</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>] == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">订单已支付</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></pre>
</div>
<p>完全符合你定义的规范，不需要你再手动检查和纠正。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="4.7 Rules 文件的进阶技巧">4.7 Rules 文件的进阶技巧</h3>
<p>技巧一：为不同目录创建不同 Rules</p>
<p><code>.cursor/rules/</code>&nbsp;目录下可以有多个&nbsp;<code>.mdc</code>&nbsp;文件，每个针对不同场景：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>.cursor/rules/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
├── api</span>-test-rules.mdc       <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 接口测试规范（作用于 tests/ api/ services/）</span>
├── api-layer-rules.mdc      <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> API 层开发规范（作用于 api/）</span>
└── general-rules.mdc        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 通用规范（alwaysApply: true）</span></pre>
</div>
<p>技巧二：在 Rules 中引用文件</p>
<p>可以在 Rules 中指定"参考这个文件的风格"：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"># 代码风格参考</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
当生成新的接口函数时，参考 `api</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">order_api.py` 的代码风格。
当生成新的测试类时，参考 `tests</span>/order/test_create_order.py` 的结构。</pre>
</div>
<p>技巧三：把常见错误场景也写进 Rules</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"># 常见错误与修正</span>

- **不要使用 time.sleep()**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">，如需等待，使用 pytest 的 `poll` 机制或重试装饰器
</span>- **不要硬编码 token**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">，必须从环境变量读取
</span>- **不要在测试中创建真实的外部资源**（如发短信、发邮件），使用 mock</pre>
</div>
<hr>
<h2 id="5. 完整实践流程总结">5. 完整实践流程总结</h2>
<p>把本篇所有内容串起来，形成一套完整的工作流：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">┌─────────────────────────────────┐
│     Step </span>1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">：喂知识给 AI          │
│  API 文档 OR F12 抓包 </span>+<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 功能描述  │
└──────────────┬──────────────────┘
               │
┌──────────────▼──────────────────┐
│     Step </span>2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">：写第一个测试用例      │
│  AI 生成 → 你校正 → 确认无误      │
└──────────────┬──────────────────┘
               │
┌──────────────▼──────────────────┐
│     Step </span>3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">：利用语义检索扩展      │
│  存量代码成为参考，增量知识即可    │
└──────────────┬──────────────────┘
               │ 代码多了，语义噪音↑
┌──────────────▼──────────────────┐
│  Step </span>4：抽象 API 层 +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Service 层 │
│  接口一处定义，公共流程集中封装    │
└──────────────┬──────────────────┘
               │
┌──────────────▼──────────────────┐
│     Step </span>5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">：编写 Rules 文件       │
│  把工程规范</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">写给 AI 看</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">，强制遵守  │
└──────────────┬──────────────────┘
               │
┌──────────────▼──────────────────┐
│     持续扩展：只需录入增量知识     │
│  新接口 → 定义到 api 层 → 写测试   │
└─────────────────────────────────┘</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<table class="table-responsive table table-bordered table-striped">
<tbody>
<tr><th>阶段</th><th>你做什么</th><th>AI 做什么</th></tr>
<tr>
<td>喂知识</td>
<td>提供接口信息或抓包数据</td>
<td>理解接口，推断边界场景</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>写第一个用例</td>
<td>审查并纠正 AI 的推断</td>
<td>生成完整测试代码</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>扩展阶段</td>
<td>只说"帮我写 XXX 的测试"</td>
<td>语义检索参考存量代码，自主生成</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>工程治理</td>
<td>维护 api 层、service 层、rules 文件</td>
<td>严格遵守规范，风格统一</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<hr>
<h2 id="小结">小结</h2>
<p>基本上，掌握了今天讲的内容， 基本上用于生成自动化测试用例领域的 AI 已经可以满足大部分需求。 事实上，AI 生成测试用例的关键就在于知识库的设计。 而我们当前的代码仓库和 rules 文件其实都是知识的一种， 它们用来指导 AI 来完成测试用例的生成。所以我再星球里一直都强调：Everything in git 的重要性。 只要放在工程里， 大模型就可以去通过语义检索来理解它，然后生成测试用例。</p>

</div>
